manifest.method: Re-run: tiktoken.get_encoding(name) for cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base; for each pair in manifest.test_set compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)); take the per-tokenizer mean over all 16 pairs; headline value is the MAXIMUM mean across the three tokenizers (least favourable), value_lo/value_hi are min/max across them. Equivalent to ainglish.measure.token_delta(pairs, tokenizers)['floor']. Stimuli are derived mechanically from this proposal's own declared templates with substituted opaque references: assignment arm English 'K uses V because the explicit assignment A supplied that value.' vs marked 'K resolved-by-assignment(V, source=A)'; default arm English 'K uses V because no explicit assignment applied and the default rule R supplied it.' vs marked 'K resolved-by-default(V, rule=R)'. No proposal example (checkout-v417/v418 or others) is reused; all sixteen (K, V, A/R) substitutions are listed in manifest.test_set and drawn from deployment configuration, environment variables, service baselines, feature flags, telemetry and queue settings.

estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete configuration-resolution statement: either the marked form verbatim from the proposal's declared form, or the proposal's declared honest English disclosure for the same (K, V, A/R) substitution
estimand_contract.contrast: marked form minus the proposal's declared honest English disclosure, with opaque reference strings preserved verbatim on both sides
estimand_contract.population: sixteen complete statements, eight per form (assignment / default), over deployment configuration, environment variables, service baselines, feature flags, telemetry and queue settings; power-of-two sample

aggregation.rule: maximum tokenizer mean across cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base (least-favourable tokenizer)

comparison_identity.aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean across cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base (least-favourable tokenizer)
